p:cNvPr.descr: The top image is of the palindrome repeat. It is a section of a 2-stranded nucleotide sequence, oriented horizontally. It is labeled on the left and has a vertically oriented circular yellow arrow, coming forward toward the viewer, intersecting with a horizontal pink circular arrow, curving toward the viewer, at the left. For the 5', the first half of the bases are blue; for 3' the second half are blue. The sequence for the top 5' strand is TTAGCACGTGCTAA. The bottom sequence for 3' is AATGCTGCACGATT. They are bonded by blue bonds in the center. Below is the mirror repeat, which is labeled on the left and only has the horizontal right-curving pink arrow. This time, the entire top 5' sequence is blue and the entire bottom 3' sequence is white. They are flipped, but the sequences are the same.
